items.title: Negative Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Imposters without color and complete reversals of your favorite mobs! Inspired by negative film and the realm of the unknown. Perfect for spooky roleplays or basic survival with friends.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Fantasia Texture Pack
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Are you looking for a fantasy experience in Minecraft? Are you wanting something to spice up your game realm just a bit more? Look no further, we have a colorful and playful pack that will transform your world into something completely new and exciting! Try out this pack for yourself, you'll be glad you did.

+ 1.19 texture pack
+ 6 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Trendy Masked Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Throw on a mask and hide your identity! Become the god of PvP and leave a mysterious legacy behind you as they try to guess who you really are. Or become an anonymous trendsetter to wow them all and keep them guessing on your next big move. Get ready to hide in plain sight!

- 8 Fashionable Masked Teens!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Scout Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Exploring the wild can be dangerous if you're not well equipped, as danger lurks around every corner. But fear not! The scout squad is here to save the day! Armed with fun, trendy, and fashionable exploration outfits and knowledge of the unknown, they're ready to face any adventure. Will you join them?

- 8 Adventurous Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Dark Glow
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Check out these awesome Dark Glow skins! Try these trendy outfits for your adventures!

- 7 Skins
- Glowing neon skins
- By KA Studios

items.title: Street Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
You will be the coolest person on the street with these skins that best reflect street fashion! Choose your favorite skin now and start playing!

+ 11 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Working Class
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Start a big company and wear cool, classy clothes!
Join the working class and pursue a great career, it's your big chance!

- 8 exclusive skins!
- Choose from many workers and business teens!

items.title: Lucky Robots
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Do you like robots? Do you like lucky blocks? Then, this is perfect for you! Enjoy this super modern skin pack and be the most technologically lucky, today!

+ 25 robots!
+ 5 different, revolutionary designs!
+ Totally cool and colorful!

items.title: Lucky Blocks World
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Lucky Blocks like everyone loves it. Try your luck in a modern city located in the middle of a stunning landscape!
Destroy the Lucky Blocks and get ready for 150 different outcomes!

- Single and multiplayer friendly
- Have fun playing!
items.changelog:
- Updated the Lucky Blocks behavior with new drops!
- Reworked the world and added a bigger terrain with custom caves and dungeons!

items.title: Lucky Blocks Sky Grid
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for a new skyblock Lucky Blocks experience? Build your way from cube to cube, test your luck with the countless Lucky Blocks, equip yourself and prepare for the battle with the Ender Dragon!

+150 different outcomes!
+Grid with thousands of cubes!

items.title: AI.ML
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Computer created Minecraft skins generated from electrons. Art made by artificial intelligence. These colorful glitch skins are perfect for all play styles. Become the computer with a character modelled by mathematics!

items.title: Dinosaurs+
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to Dinosaurs+! Roleplay in a zoo filled with dinosaurs! Tame, fly, or ride them!

+ 6 dinosaur additions!
+ 4 skins included
+ 1 FREE skin
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Famous Anime Friends
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Get ready! Anime Style is back in town! Put on the latest fashion clothes and become your authentic self. Binge-watch anime or play games with your friends while listening to music. Choose the skin that fits your style the best. Get ready!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Dream Squad
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Your local teens are back in town! They have woken up from a dream and have come up with new fashion ideas! Choose your favorite skin and show your friends how cool you are!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 11 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Greek Paradise
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Welcome to paradise! Here you will find the most beautiful lands of ancient Greece. Explore the island, search the seas for mysterious lands, and build your home in Greek Paradise!
+ 5 skins

items.title: Pets
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Have you ever wondered how life would be as a pet? Take over the role of a pet and surprise your friends with your cute new looks! Or you can just take it easy and get a glance at how different your everyday life could go.

+ 10 cute skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Pets 
+ Animals

Created by Mine-North

It's time to put on some stylish clothing, designed specifically for fall!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Skins look cool all year round!

items.description:
Want to look your coolest? Great - now you can! Put on some of these stylish designer outfits, and make your friends instantly jealous.

+ 12 rich teens
+ Cool outfits

Illagers Assemble! It is time to pillage the villages!

+ 12 cartoon themed skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Made by rvan

items.title: Mob Cyborgs
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
The mobs have improved their abilities by becoming CYBORGS. They think you should lead them. It's time for you to take control of the mobs, each one with a unique design; you can stand out among friends with this incredible pack.

- Two totally free skins
- Fourteen Skins 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Dark Demons
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Become a demon and show your new horns in your dark outfit!

- Ten unique demon skins!
- One skin totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.
